packageRules.description: playwright 1.62 cannot resolve the package-style extends (@grafana/tsconfig) in .config/tsconfig.json; hold until the Grafana scaffold supports it

@grafana/eslint-config 10 dropped the ./flat.js subpath export that .config/eslint.config.mjs imports, and peers @stylistic/eslint-plugin >=5 in place of @stylistic/eslint-plugin-ts; @grafana/create-plugin 7.9.2 still scaffolds both the flat.js import and ^9.0.0, so hold until the scaffold moves
eslint 10 has no lockfile solution here: eslint-plugin-react 7.37.5 still peers eslint <=^9.7 and the Grafana scaffold pins ^9.32.0; lift once both support 10

@grafana/data and @grafana/runtime 13.1.x peer react ^18.0.0 and react-dom ^18.0.0, so react 19 cannot resolve at all (npm ci fails with ERESOLVE); the @types move with the runtime packages so they do not drift ahead. Lift once the @grafana packages peer react 19
